title: Add expense activity history foundation
summary: Expense activity history foundation adds tracking of lifecycle events for expense reports with an append-only activity log table, read-only APIs scoped by report and user role, factbox UI components, and comprehensive test coverage.
key_points: New append-only activity log table records expense report lifecycle events (Created, Submitted, Approved, Rejected, Posted, etc.)
Activity log captures actor, role, comments, financial snapshots, categories, and receipt counts for each event
Read-only APIs expose activity history filtered by report scope or limited to Expense User role with actor role requirements
Factbox components display activity history in active/posted reports and manager views
ActivityLog capability registered with comprehensive unit, API, and posting tests
quote: add a single append-only expense activity table whose source reference moves from the active report to the posted report
